title: Return policy for unused items
content: Unused, unopened items can be returned within 30 days of purchase with a receipt for a full refund to the original payment method.

title: Return policy for medicine
content: For safety reasons, opened or used medications and health products cannot be returned or exchanged, except in the case of a pharmacy dispensing error.

title: Standard shipping time
content: Standard shipping typically takes 3 to 5 business days. Orders placed before 2pm on business days usually leave the warehouse the same day.

title: International shipping
content: We currently ship only within the country. Prescription medications and controlled substances cannot be shipped internationally under any circumstances.

title: Accepted payment methods
content: We accept major credit and debit cards, HSA/FSA cards, gift cards, and insurance co-pay billing for eligible prescriptions.

title: Subscription cancellation policy
content: Recurring prescription or product subscriptions can be canceled anytime from your account before the next scheduled shipment with no cancellation fee.

title: Changing a shipping address
content: A shipping address can be changed only before an order enters processing. Once an order has shipped, the address cannot be modified and the order cannot be redirected.

title: Privacy policy summary
content: We collect only the information needed to fulfill orders, prescriptions, and appointments, and never sell personal health information to third parties.

title: Transferring a prescription
content: Prescriptions can be transferred from another pharmacy by providing the prescription number and the name and phone number of the previous pharmacy.

title: Auto-refill policy
content: Eligible prescriptions can be enrolled in auto-refill, which processes and ships automatically a few days before the current supply runs out. It can be turned off anytime.

title: Late delivery policy
content: If a delivery is more than 3 days past its estimated date, contact support for a status update or a shipping fee refund where applicable.

title: Damaged item policy
content: Items that arrive damaged are replaced or refunded at no cost. Report damage within 7 days of delivery with a photo if possible.

title: Price adjustment policy
content: If an item you purchased drops in price within 7 days, contact support for a one-time price adjustment refund of the difference.

title: Loyalty points expiration
content: Loyalty points expire after 12 months of account inactivity. Any purchase or redemption resets the expiration clock.

title: Age restrictions on certain products
content: Certain over-the-counter medications containing restricted ingredients require a valid photo ID and are limited to customers 18 and older.

title: Photo ID requirement at pickup
content: A government-issued photo ID is required to pick up prescription medications and certain regulated over-the-counter products in-store.

title: Pausing a subscription
content: Subscriptions can be paused for up to 3 months from your account without cancelling, and will resume automatically unless you cancel first.

title: Data retention policy
content: Order and prescription records are retained for 7 years as required by pharmacy regulations, even if you close your account.

title: Warranty on health devices
content: Health monitoring devices such as blood pressure monitors and thermometers carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects, not accidental damage.

title: Medicine take-back and disposal
content: Expired or unused medications can be dropped off at any store's take-back kiosk for safe disposal — please do not dispose of medication in household trash.
